question: What is Riot buffing and nerfing on Kog'Maw, which way are they pushing him, and should runes and items follow?

patch.ugg: 26.22 (URL 16_22), the latest full patch. 26.23 had 30 NA Diamond+ Kog games on 2026-11-23, too few.

caveat: Patch notes say what changed, not why. Everything under 'direction' is inferred from the pattern of changes. Kog's own page also leaves out item and system changes (Doran's Bow, boots, on-hit items), which move his builds as much as his own numbers do.

dials.note: Rank 5 (rank 3 for R) values after each change, read from the wiki patch history. Each series starts at the first change in the window (2015 on) and holds until the next one.

series.label: W: max HP per hit (rank 5)
series.read: Peaked at 7% twice, trimmed back to 6% each time. Flat since 2023.

series.label: Q passive: bonus attack speed (rank 5)
series.read: Only ever goes down. The free attack speed in his kit is shrinking.

series.label: Q: AP ratio
series.read: Only ever goes up. Three raises, the last two in 2025.

series.label: W: max HP per 100 AP
series.read: Untouched for nine years, then +50% in 25.17.

series.label: R: AP ratio (rank 3)
series.read: Up twice. 25.17 made it grow with rank.

series.label: Q: base damage (rank 5)
series.read: Cut in 25.04 while the AP ratio went up: flat power moved into scaling.

recent.note: Every gameplay change from V13.1 to V26.22 (bug fixes left out unless they change how he plays). Buff, nerf or neutral is a judgement for Kog's power, not Riot's label.

changes.text: Passive: 140 to 650 damage (from 125 to 550), now ghosted
Q cooldown 8 to 7 s. E mana 60 to 40 at rank 1
Passive +10% move speed. E slow 40–60%. Q cast = attack windup
Q shred 23–31% to 16–32%: weaker early, a bit stronger at rank 5
Q base 90–290 to 80–260, AP ratio 70% to 80%
Q 90% AP, W +1.5% HP per 100 AP, R up to 45% AP
W fixed to act as a normal on-hit effect (26.10: procs Statikk Shiv)
Base MR 30 to 33, growth 1.3 to 1.1 (same at 15, less late)

categories.label: AP ratios and base damage
categories.verdict: Up. Base damage traded for AP scaling, then AP buffed outright.

categories.label: Attack speed and W %HP
categories.verdict: Down. Q attack speed cut twice, W %HP held at 6%.

categories.label: AD scaling
categories.verdict: Small buff. R AD ratio once (14.5).

categories.label: Safety and utility
categories.verdict: Up in 2023–24: passive, E slow, Q feel.

categories.label: Base stats
categories.verdict: Left alone. Only clean-ups since the 12.10 durability patch.

eras.text: Launch kit: armor pen Q, stacking artillery R. Riot mostly tuned R spam (stack caps, mana).
The rework years. W becomes %HP + range (5.22), attack speed moves to Q (6.19), R gets its execute (6.21).
Base stat fixes (7.22, 8.11, 12.10). AP ratios up (10.13, 11.18). W %HP rides 5–7%.
Safety buffs (passive, E, Q feel) while W and Q shred are trimmed.
The AP era: Q, W and R AP ratios raised, Q base and attack speed cut.

apMath.note: Rank 5 Q and W, rank 3 R, before 25.04 vs now, from the patch history. AP only (AD parts left out). R is the minimum hit (target above 60% HP); it doubles below 40% HP.

coachless.note: WPA = win rate minus the average pre-game win probability, in points. Buys are item purchases. At 1,000 buys the 95% noise on a win rate is about ±3 points, so every gap here is a lean.
